Resolves #20616

🌿 A claimant who posts a progress note can no longer lose the ticket to the next person who asks.

Two halves of one rule:
- **`CONTRIBUTING.md` §3, step 3.** The first claim reserves the ticket from the automatic reply, and the assignment confirms it. A maintainer can also release a claim from an account that sprays them, which keeps the screening the responder's header describes. A claim lasts 7 days, and any comment from the claimant starts them again. The 7-day rule (#7426) predates the responder (#19211), which is why it still keyed on the assignment.
- **The responder agrees.** `earlierClaim` measured the 7 days from the claim comment and renewed them only with another claim-shaped comment. A claimant who wrote "Implementation is complete; tests are in progress." on day 7 lost the ticket to a second claimant on day 8; that is Sophie's exact-head falsifier. The window now runs from the claimant's latest comment on the issue.

The new step reads:

> If you are, your claim reserves the ticket from that reply: start right away. A maintainer confirms the claim by assigning you, and can release a claim from an account that sprays them. […] A claim is what protects your time. To keep the project moving, a claim lasts 7 days, and any comment you leave on the ticket starts the 7 days again. After 7 days without a word from you, the ticket may go to another contributor.

Evidence: L2 (unit: the new spec is red on `dev`'s responder and green with the fix) → L2 required (AC-3 is responder behavior; AC-1 and AC-2 are wording).

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

| AC-1 | Step 3: "a claim lasts 7 days, and any comment you leave on the ticket starts the 7 days again". |
| AC-2 | Step 3: "A maintainer confirms the claim by assigning you", and "A claim is what protects your time" replaces "An assignment is what protects your time". |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `claimResponse.spec.mjs`, "any later comment from the claimant keeps the claim". A claim on Oct 31 and a progress note on Nov 7 hold the ticket against a claim on Nov 8, and it is free again 7 days after the note. |
